description: Cross-binding conformance for an ARRAY-shaped OBSERVED written ELEMENTWISE over another array and consumed ONLY through an `index(f, j)` gather inside an `aggregate` body. `zc` is a const field shaped [lev]; `f = 1 + cos(pi*zc)` is the natural, spec-legible spelling of a per-level field (esm-spec §4.3.4 elementwise broadcast over index-set names); `colsum[i] = Σ_{j≤i} f[j]` and `total = Σ_j f[j]` read it through gathers and nothing else reads it at all. A binding that inlines `f` into its readers by name substitution turns the gather into `index(1 + cos(pi*zc), j)` and must DISTRIBUTE it over the elementwise combination all the way down to the array leaf — `1 + cos(pi*index(zc, j))` — which is exact, not an approximation. Julia's tree-walk resolver tested only the IMMEDIATE operands of the combination for array-ness, so a leaf one level down under a `cos` matched nothing, the gather was dropped, and `zc` reached the compiler bare as `E_TREEWALK_UNBOUND_VARIABLE: zc` (issue #175): the elementwise document was portable to Python and Rust but not to the reference binding. Julia: FIXED (`_index_pushdown_arrayish` recurses through nested elementwise ops and spans every array SOURCE the resolver can gather — array state slot, forcing buffer, const array); Python and Rust already evaluated it. Julia is the reference binding: its `run_pde_tests` minted both goldens. The category carries a controlled PAIR: `elementwise_gather` is the shape under test, and `explicit_gather` is the identical field written as an explicit `aggregate(k from lev; 1 + cos(pi*index(zc, k)))` — the spelling that never needed the push-down. The two share every assertion and every expected value, so a divergence between them is the gather push-down and cannot be the physics. Both right-hand sides are state-FREE, so `u(t) = colsum·t` and `s(t) = total·t` are integrated exactly by every pinned solver family and the goldens are integrator-independent to machine precision: a divergence here is a semantics divergence, never an integrator one.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator / inline PDE-test runner
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator / inline PDE-test runner
